## Why use Plausible Analytics?

Google Analytics is overkill for most site owners. Plausible gives you clear, useful insights without complexity, training, or prior analytics experience.

**Automatic scroll depth tracking** — Scroll depth (1–100%) tracked on every page automatically. No setup, no tag managers. Create scroll-depth goals without code.

**Monitor traffic from AI tools** — See which AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) send traffic. Identify pages attracting AI visitors and the conversions they complete.

**Analyze SEO performance** — Connect Search Console to view search queries and organic performance directly in Plausible. Track SEO content and conversions in one place.

**Measure paid ads & campaigns** — Track UTM campaigns with automatic channel grouping (Paid Search, Affiliates). Analyze landing pages, conversions, and locations.

**Real-time dashboard** — Live traffic with the same metrics as your main dashboard. Updates every 30 seconds, no refresh needed.

**Codeless goals & revenue tracking** — Turn any page into a goal. Auto-track file downloads, form completions, external link clicks. Set up custom events and revenue tracking.

**Funnels & user journeys** — Measure drop-off across a fixed step sequence, or explore actual visitor paths to discover unexpected flows.

**Built-in bot filtering** — Excludes bots, referrer spam, and data-center traffic out of the box so stats reflect real human visits.
